A banking and currency exchange application implemented in R for a
programming languages course.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`convertCurrency()`](convertCurrency.md) : Convert Currency
- [`currencyExchange()`](currencyExchange.md) : Currency Exchange
- [`depositAmount()`](depositAmount.md) : Deposit Amount
- [`getConsoleInput()`](getConsoleInput.md) : Clean Console Input
- [`getValidAmount()`](getValidAmount.md) : Valid Choice I/O For
  Numeric/Double Value
- [`getValidChoice()`](getValidChoice.md) : Validate a Choice I/O
- [`getValidChoiceClean()`](getValidChoiceClean.md) : Validate a Choice
  I/O Without Prints
- [`getValidName()`](getValidName.md) : Valid Choice I/O For Name
- [`getValidYN()`](getValidYN.md) : Validate a Yes/No Response
- [`main()`](main.md) : Main Program Function
- [`printExchangeMenu()`](printExchangeMenu.md) : Exchange Menu
- [`printNavMenu()`](printNavMenu.md) : Navigation Menu
- [`recordExchangeRates()`](recordExchangeRates.md) : Record Exchange
  Rate
- [`registerAccountName()`](registerAccountName.md) : Register Account
- [`showInterestAmount()`](showInterestAmount.md) : Show Interest Amount
- [`withdrawAmount()`](withdrawAmount.md) : Withdraw Amount
